description: Library of functions to format test scripts' output in JUnit XML for Git test suite results, supporting Azure Pipelines integration.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes JUnit XML output for a test suite, creating directories and setting up XML structure.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Records start time for a test case.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes a test case, recording its result and appending to the XML report.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Completes the overall test suite XML, adjusting timing and closing tags.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Writes XML content to the output file, with optional truncation.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings for XML attributes, optionally without line feeds.
